description:
The model thinking-level indicator was added to the footer, but two parity gaps remain compared to the Node.js upstream.

**IMPLEMENTED (Elixir) — status bar right-side:**
```
minimax/minimax-m2.7 · off
```

**EXPECTED (Node.js upstream) — status bar right-side:**
```
minimax/minimax-m2.7 • thinking off
```

**Gaps:**

1. **Wrong separator character**: Elixir uses `·` (U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT) but upstream uses `•` (U+2022 BULLET).
   - Fix in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/footer.ex`, `model_part/1`

2. **"thinking off" label vs "off"**: When the thinking level is `:off`, upstream shows the word `"thinking off"` not just `"off"`. All other levels (low / medium / high) are shown verbatim.
   - Upstream reference: `footer.ts` line ~162: `thinkingLevel === "off" ? \`${modelName} • thinking off\` : \`${modelName} • ${thinkingLevel}\``
   - Fix in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`, `thinking_level_label/1`: return `"thinking off"` for `:off` atom

**Verification:**
Compare the bottom-right of both TUIs in `tmux pi-comparison` with a reasoning-capable model (`-m openrouter/minimax/minimax-m2.7`).
title: TUI-3: Missing model quality/speed indicator ('medium') in status bar
